notes.title: UNDERWORLD DREAMS® - The False King || Development Update
notes.content:
We want to share an [b]Underworld Dreams® - The False King[/b] Development Update.

[b]Underworld Dreams® - The False King[/b] was announced as an exclusive Nintendo™ Switch title in October 2019. It has been developed from the beginning with Nintendo Switch™ in mind to assure a great performance and quality.

For a while, we announced a PC version thanks to the interest of a publisher. However, without that support  and after evaluating our options and circumstances at that moment, we decided to not continue with that version.

For this reason, since [url=https://youtu.be/_PyU5z-zWCQ]last trailer[/url] in October 2022 we announced again that it would be exclusive on Nintendo Switch™. About the PC version, we don't rule out the possibility to release the game in the future, but currently is not part of our plans.

Thank you to understanding and continued support. We remain committed to offering you an exceptional gaming experience.

Stay tuned for more news and updates about [b]Underworld Dreams® - The False King[/b]!  

The Drop Of Pixel Team

notes.title: Try Underworld Dreams The False King for the First time @ Steam Fest!
notes.content:
For a limited time only, get your hands on the first portion of Underworld Dreams: The False King as we participate in the Steam Next! 

Experience a thrill-seeking adventure as you make your way through the demo, fighting off fanatics, investigating your haunted surroundings, and more! 

Streaming your playthrough? Let us know [url=twitter.com/play_underworld]@play_underworld[/url] so we can feature you!
